The Raft Consensus Algorithm

Raft is a consensus algorithm that is designed to be easy to understand.

Raft elects a leader, and the leader replicates log entries to the other servers.

Consensus means that a cluster of servers agrees on the same sequence of values even when some servers fail.

Raft was designed by Diego Ongaro and John Ousterhout at Stanford University.
